access: developer exhaustive finite-method screen and constructive witness, not player evidence
explanation: All complete three-moment opening diaries are already used. Any fixed thermostat makes immediate and retained heat identical. Any uncontrolled lamp trajectory makes direct-light and immediate-heat opening identical. A union of complementary methods separates all three without naming a required recipe.

things.label: Keep both chambers cool
things.effect: Clamp warmth to 0 throughout both trials, blocking current and retained heat.

things.label: Keep both chambers warm
things.effect: Clamp warmth to 1 throughout both trials, regardless of the lamp.

things.label: Brief light pulse
things.effect: Keep the left chamber dark; light the right chamber only in the middle moment. Preserve the existing thermostat setting.

things.label: Steady light
things.effect: Keep the left chamber dark and the right chamber lit for all three moments. Preserve the existing thermostat setting.

things.label: Let chamber warmth respond
things.effect: Remove the thermostat clamp, allowing warmth to follow each explanation. Preserve the light schedule.

things.label: Record leaf opening
things.effect: Make a result containing every explanation’s exact opening diary for both chambers. No secret correct explanation is selected.
